title: City of Bones
description: A Brooklyn teenager watches three tattooed strangers kill something in a nightclub that nobody else can see. The series that carried urban fantasy through the 2010s.

title: Clockwork Angel
description: Victorian London demon-hunters, a girl who can take on the shape of the dead, and clockwork automata. Better plotted than the contemporary series it precedes.

title: Cinder
description: Cinderella as a cyborg mechanic in a plague-ridden New Beijing, with a lunar colony threatening war. The fairy-tale retelling that made the shelf.

title: Miss Peregrine's Home for Peculiar Children
description: A boy follows his grandfather's stories to a Welsh island and a house caught in a single 1940 day. Built around real found vernacular photographs.

title: Shatter Me
description: A girl imprisoned because her touch kills is taken out of her cell to be used as a weapon. Written in a striking struck-through interior voice.

title: Red Queen
description: A world split between red-blooded commoners and silver-blooded superhumans, and a thief who turns out to be neither. Court intrigue with a rebellion underneath.

title: The Wrath and the Dawn
description: A girl volunteers to marry the caliph who takes a bride every night and kills her by dawn, intending to avenge her friend. A Thousand and One Nights, retold.

title: The Gilded Wolves
description: A crew of outsiders run a heist through 1889 Paris for a secret order that has excluded every one of them. Puzzle-box plotting and a pointed view of empire.

title: The Scorpio Races
description: An island where carnivorous water horses come ashore each November and are raced, usually fatally. A girl enters on an ordinary mare. Atmosphere over plot, and it works.

title: The Raven Boys
description: A psychic's daughter told she will kill her true love with a kiss falls in with four private-school boys hunting a buried Welsh king in Virginia.

title: Daughter of Smoke and Bone
description: A blue-haired art student in Prague runs errands collecting teeth for the chimaera who raised her. The war she was born out of is older than she knows.

title: Strange the Dreamer
description: A librarian obsessed with a city whose name was stolen from memory joins the expedition that finds it. Ornate, and the ending is genuinely cruel.

title: The Sun Is Also a Star
description: A Jamaican girl twelve hours from deportation and a Korean-American boy on his way to a Yale interview, across one day in New York.

title: Everything, Everything
description: A girl allergic to the outside world has never left her house, and a boy moves in next door. The reveal reframes the whole premise.

title: They Both Die at the End
description: A service calls to tell you it is your last day. Two strangers use an app to find someone to spend it with. The title is not a misdirection.

title: All the Bright Places
description: Two teenagers meet on a school bell tower ledge, each there for their own reasons, and map their Indiana county together. Careful about bipolar disorder.

title: Turtles All the Way Down
description: A girl with intrusive thoughts about her own gut bacteria investigates a missing billionaire. Green writing his own OCD from the inside.

title: The Poet X
description: A Dominican-American girl in Harlem writes slam poetry her devout mother would burn. In verse, and it won the National Book Award.

title: With the Fire on High
description: A teenage mother in Philadelphia with a gift for cooking is offered a culinary course she cannot afford to want. Warm and unsentimental about childcare.

title: On the Come Up
description: A sixteen-year-old rapper's battle track goes viral for the wrong reasons while her family faces eviction. About being made into a caricature by your own success.

title: Dear Martin
description: A scholarship student at a mostly white prep school writes letters to Martin Luther King after being handcuffed for helping a friend.

title: Ghost
description: A boy who learned to run the night his father shot at him joins an elite track team. First of four, one per runner.

title: The Marrow Thieves
description: In a world that has lost the ability to dream, Indigenous people are hunted for their bone marrow. A group walks north. Residential schools, barely fictionalised.

title: The Inheritance Games
description: A girl working diner shifts inherits a billionaire's fortune on condition she lives in his house with the four grandsons she disinherited.

title: A Good Girl's Guide to Murder
description: A sixth-former reopens a closed murder-suicide for her school project, with case files and interview transcripts reproduced in the text.

title: Truly Devious
description: A true-crime obsessive wins a place at a Vermont academy to solve its 1936 kidnapping, and a student dies in her first term.

title: Crooked Kingdom
description: The Crows are owed money and a friend, and the city is closing on them. The back half of one story, and it lands everything the first book set up.

title: Ninth House
description: A survivor with no qualifications is given a full ride to Yale to monitor the secret societies' real magic. Adult, and considerably darker than her YA.

title: A Torch Against the Night
description: A prison break across a hostile empire, with three narrators now instead of two. The empire's cruelty stops being background.

title: Children of Virtue and Vengeance
description: Magic is back and now the monarchy has it too. The sequel is largely about whether a liberation movement can avoid becoming what it fought.

title: Legendborn
description: A grieving Black teenager at a UNC early-college programme finds an Arthurian secret society on campus and a bloodline it never accounted for.

title: Cemetery Boys
description: A trans Latinx brujo summons a ghost to prove himself to his family and cannot send it back. Warm about family, sharp about being seen.

title: Iron Widow
description: Girls are fed to giant mecha as fuel for male pilots until one survives and starts killing hers. Furious, and based on China's only female emperor.

title: The Dragon Republic
description: After the atrocity that ended the first book, Rin fights a civil war on the side of a republic she does not trust. Opium addiction written properly.

title: Babel
description: An Oxford translation institute powers the British empire with silver bars that hold what is lost between languages. A campus novel that argues violence is the only lever.

title: The Atlas Six
description: Six young magicians compete for five places in a secret society guarding the library of Alexandria. Talky, and the arguments are the appeal.

title: Vicious
description: Two graduate students prove that near-death experiences produce superpowers and try it on each other. Ten years later one is out of prison. No heroes.

title: The Wicked King
description: Jude holds the faerie throne through a boy who hates her and has five months to make it permanent. The betrayal at the end is the series' best moment.

title: Alanna: The First Adventure
description: A girl swaps places with her twin brother and trains as a page in disguise. A generation of fantasy readers started here.

title: Sabriel
description: A schoolgirl crosses the wall into a country where the dead do not stay dead, to find her father the necromancer. The bell-based magic is exceptional.

title: Charmed Life
description: An orphan and his manipulative older sister are taken in by an enchanter, and the boy has nine lives he keeps losing. Sharp about sibling cruelty.

title: The Dark Is Rising
description: A boy wakes on his eleventh birthday into deep snow and the knowledge that he is the last of the Old Ones. English midwinter myth, done seriously.

title: The Book of Three
description: An assistant pig-keeper who wants to be a hero, in a Prydain built from Welsh legend. Five books, and the last of them is unusually sad.

title: Redwall
description: A mouse defends an abbey from a rat warlord. Written for children at a school for the blind, which is why every feast is described at such length.

title: The City of Ember
description: An underground city whose generator is failing, and two twelve-year-olds with a shredded set of instructions for leaving.

title: The Mysterious Benedict Society
description: Four gifted orphans pass a very strange entrance exam and are sent undercover into a boarding school broadcasting subliminal messages.

title: Artemis Fowl
description: A twelve-year-old criminal mastermind kidnaps a fairy for ransom and discovers the fairies have better technology than he does.

title: Skulduggery Pleasant
description: A twelve-year-old inherits her uncle's estate and his business partner, a skeleton detective. Very funny, and it gets much darker across the series.

title: Nevermoor: The Trials of Morrigan Crow
description: A girl cursed to die on her eleventh birthday is spirited to a hidden city and entered into trials for a society she has no talent for.

title: Amari and the Night Brothers
description: A girl on scholarship is recruited to the Bureau of Supernatural Affairs to find her missing brother, and tests as the thing everyone there fears.

title: The Girl Who Drank the Moon
description: A town sacrifices an infant to the forest witch each year. The witch has been rescuing them all along, and accidentally feeds one moonlight.

title: When You Reach Me
description: A sixth-grader in 1979 Manhattan starts receiving notes that predict things. A quiet mystery that is also a conversation with A Wrinkle in Time.
